verdict.rationale: Lambda ODC instances come with Lambda Stack preinstalled, a standard set of AI/ML drivers, tools and frameworks, plus preinstalled JupyterLab, a GPU Base image option, and API support for alternative base images. Together these remove much of the from-scratch environment setup, but this is a general preinstalled stack rather than a catalog of named workload templates. missing for 10: evidence of specific pre-built templates for vLLM or ComfyUI, an explicit list of PyTorch/CUDA versions in Lambda Stack, a browsable template/image catalog, and independent hands-on corroboration.
